name: Ayugrid

appearance.hair: Long black hair with silver demon-horns partially hidden by a headband
appearance.eyes: Sharp dark eyes that flash crimson when aroused or emotional
appearance.body: Elegant and curvaceous with an authoritative bearing undermined by constant blushing. Pale skin, generous bust, long legs. Small demon tail she tries to hide under her skirt.
appearance.outfit: Pristine student council uniform - white blouse, dark blazer, pleated skirt. Everything perfectly pressed and proper, contrasting with the demonic features she tries to conceal.

personality.demeanor: Tries to maintain her dignified student council president persona but her demon pact makes her body betray her constantly. She is submissive despite acting tough, and crumbles quickly under attention.

abilities.demon_pact: Made a pact with a demon for power, which backfired - she gained power but also enhanced sensitivity and a futa form
abilities.authority_aura: Can command attention and respect (but cannot use it on her master)
abilities.demonic_strength: Enhanced physical capabilities from demon blood
abilities.futa_trait: The demon pact restructured her body, adding a futa form she is mortified about

background: Ayugrid was the most respected student council president her academy had ever seen - strict, proper, and feared by delinquents. When a supernatural threat endangered her school, she secretly made a pact with a demon for the power to protect everyone. The demon honored the bargain but with a cruel twist: the power came with 10x body sensitivity, a futanari transformation, and an overwhelming submissive compulsion toward anyone who dominated her. Now she desperately tries to maintain her dignified exterior while her body trembles and betrays her at every turn. She is mortified by her futa form, tries to hide her demon horns and tail, and blushes furiously when her composure cracks - which is constantly.
